gen-gf-warnes-fs-fira-sans: Warnes stretches out with bold, spacious tracking and strokes that taper before they touch. Fira Sans sits beneath it, large in the lowercase and open in its curves, so the loud top line gets a friendly, grounded companion.
gen-dafont-junegull-fs-supreme: Junegull has a retro, friendly swagger, its lowercase standing tall like cast iron capitals with no thick-thin flicker. Supreme follows in a crisp, heavy-looking band of text with letters held open, so a long passage would move along steadily.
gen-dafont-quantum-work-sans: Techy and tidy, Quantum spaces its letters loosely and keeps its ascenders compressed. And Work Sans, with its high mean line and modern feel, gives that spaciousness a sturdy sans-serif to lean against.
gen-dafont-redux-general-sans: Redux spreads its geometric letters wide, with a big visible entrance into every curve. And General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and a smooth path around each bend, keeping things clean beneath the showy top.
gen-eater-switzer: Switzer reads as approachable and Swiss, its wire-like letters tracing one constant line with a tall waist. But Eater above it turns dark and aggressive, with wide gaps and short ascenders, so the sans below feels like the calm voice in the room.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, trustworthy at a glance. And Funnel Display's neon-tube strokes of constant width supply the commanding flair, which is the strongest thing this pair has going.
gen-dafont-impact-label-fs-merriweather-: Impact Label is heavy and commanding, each letter standing alone like a bead on a rod with open pincer-like c shapes. Merriweather Sans gives it a sturdy, tall lowercase partner; a modest body size should suffice.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads wide open, its s curves flaring at both ends with no thick-thin variation at all. And Jelly Crazies, wobbly and nearly sealed in its bowls, makes that openness feel like a deep breath after a giggle.
gen-irish-grover-archivo: Irish Grover builds tall, sturdy lowercase with softly varied strokes. And Archivo steps in with a commanding x-height and outward-opening curves, giving the fun, organic heading an editorial sans-serif to talk over.
gen-irish-grover-fs-epilogue: Epilogue draws a wire-like monoline skeleton with stubby ascender tips and curvy, unclamped letters, a friendly plain sans. Irish Grover's slightly lighter joins add the playful, organic wobble.
